events.label: Pradhan resigns
events.description: Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan resigned and the protests were called off -- the first cabinet resignation forced by street protest in this term.

events.label: Sansad Chalo march
events.description: CJP march on Parliament met with baton charges and tear gas; injuries and mass detentions.

events.label: CJP Jantar Mantar protests
events.description: Cockroach Janta Party and left student groups occupied Jantar Mantar for 50 days over exam irregularities, demanding Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation. Sonam Wangchuk began a hunger strike on 28 Jun and was hospitalised on 18 Jul.

events.label: CJI 'cockroach' remark / CJP founded
events.description: CJI Surya Kant compared unemployed youth and activists to 'cockroaches' and 'parasites of society'. Abhijeet Dipke launched the satirical Cockroach Janta Party the next day; it passed 20 million Instagram followers within days.

events.label: NEET-UG 2026 cancelled
events.description: NTA cancelled NEET-UG 2026 over a question paper leak and referred the case to the CBI. The trigger for everything that followed.

events.label: UGC equity regulations row
events.description: UGC (Promotion of Equity in Higher Education Institutions) Regulations 2026 notified on 13 Jan; #RollbackUGC protests at UGC HQ and Delhi University on 27-28 Jan; Supreme Court stayed the rules as 'vague' on 29 Jan. Dharmendra Pradhan defended them publicly on 27 Jan.

events.label: GST rate overhaul
events.description: Consumption tax slabs restructured; headline rates cut on mass-market goods.

events.label: US tariffs on India
events.description: US tariff escalation on Indian goods; exporter and employment pressure in textiles, gems, shrimp.

events.label: Electoral roll revision (SIR)
events.description: Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls; contested deletions became a national dispute.

events.label: US-Iran strikes
events.description: Israel/US strikes on Iran and the Strait of Hormuz risk premium; crude and freight spike.

events.label: Operation Sindoor
events.description: Indian strikes following the Pahalgam attack; brief India-Pakistan military exchange.

events.label: 2024 Result
events.description: Counting day: NDA 293, INDIA 234, Others 16. BJP short of a single-party majority.

events.label: 2024 General Election
events.description: 18th Lok Sabha polling, seven phases.

events.label: Farm protest (2nd round)
events.description: Delhi Chalo march over legally guaranteed MSP, during the pre-2024 campaign window.

events.label: Manipur violence
events.description: Onset of prolonged ethnic violence in Manipur.

events.label: Agnipath protests
events.description: Protests over short-term military recruitment, concentrated in Bihar and UP.

events.label: Fuel price peak
events.description: Retail petrol and diesel prices at record highs after successive daily revisions.

events.label: Russia-Ukraine war
events.description: Invasion of Ukraine; global energy and food price shock feeding domestic inflation.

events.label: Delta wave
events.description: Second COVID wave; oxygen and hospital capacity crisis.

events.label: Farm law protests
events.description: Year-long farmer sit-in at Delhi borders; the three farm laws were repealed on 19 Nov 2021.

events.label: Galwan clash
events.description: India-China border clash in the Galwan valley.

events.label: COVID lockdown
events.description: National lockdown; the sharpest single contraction in the tracker series.

events.label: CAA/NRC protests
events.description: Nationwide protests over the Citizenship Amendment Act; Delhi riots in February 2020.

events.label: 2019 Result
events.description: Counting day: NDA 353, UPA 91, Others 98.

events.label: 2019 General Election
events.description: 17th Lok Sabha polling, seven phases. NDA won 353 seats on 45.0% vote share.

events.label: Pulwama / Balakot
events.description: Pulwama attack followed by the Balakot airstrike, weeks before the 2019 campaign.
